page.content:
Attitude Era rule-breakers led by Triple H and Shawn Michaels.

How D-Generation X connects

  • Character: Triple H — Triple H led later chapters of D-Generation X.
  • Character: Shawn Michaels — Shawn Michaels co-founded D-Generation X with Triple H.
  • Concept: Attitude Era — D-Generation X was an Attitude Era engine.

What is D-Generation X?

D-Generation X was the crotch-chop stable that mocked the office, invaded WCW on Nitro, and made Triple H and Shawn Michaels the Attitude Era's mischievous engine.

Key threads lead to Triple H, Shawn Michaels and Attitude Era.
